propositions: Contributors and agents fast-forward the shared main checkout instead of their own worktree after a Gerrit merge, clobbering uncommitted operator WIP and breaking the close precheck which requires the merged rebar-ticket: commit reachable from HEAD.

The close completion verifier (_referencing_commit_exists at transition_close.py:32-57) reads git log over repo_root with ref=HEAD and fails with 'cannot confirm the work landed' when the operator's worktree is not fast-forwarded to the merged commit.

AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md lack explicit post-merge guidance instructing operators to fast-forward ONLY their own worktree (via git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main) and never touch the shared main checkout.
Documentation must clarify that the shared main checkout must remain untouched and that worktree advancement must occur before ticket close to satisfy the precheck's git log verification.
